meta.private_notes: At 8:10 clock time of the second period there was a delay for the officials to discuss if there was goalie interference on the play.  After a one minute delay the officials called it a good goal.

Following a play at 13:46 of the second period, the Firebirds initiated a Coach's Challenge for offside against the Wranglers. After a stoppage of just under four minutes, the call was overturned and the challenge was deemed successful.
